No. The 67.7 ha tree-cover loss was recorded in **2020**, before the 31 December 2020 cut-off.

No loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on the property during 2021–2025. The data did record 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021. Smaller or narrow changes may be missed, and this evidence alone does not establish EUDR compliance.
